 To drive success in this role, you must be a pioneer in the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape. You will take ownership of solving complex NLP problems by bringing rigorous scientific measurement to prompt engineering and model training. You will collaborate heavily with our product and engineering teams, guiding them on how to best structure data schemas for LLM consumption, how to fine\-tune for edge cases, and how to measure success.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement robust frameworks to quantitatively evaluate LLM performance (accuracy, repeatability, hallucination rates) before and after deployment.
* Lead the fine\-tuning and optimization of our Core Policy Models.
* Act as the central GenAI expert for product engineering teams. Guide them on improving JSON payload structures, advanced prompt engineering techniques, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures, and evaluation pipelines.
* Establish best practices, playbooks, and standardized pipelines for all AI/LLM integrations across Cover Genius.
* Stay at the cutting edge of Generative AI research, actively identifying new models, tools, and methodologies that can improve our operational efficiency and product offerings.


**What You Will Bring**
* Master's or PhD in Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or other Quantitative fields.
* 5\+ years of practical, hands\-on ML/Data Science experience, with a heavy emphasis on NLP and at least 1\-2 years dedicated to deep Generative AI/LLM applications.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, RAG architectures, and model fine\-tuning techniques.
* Deep understanding of how to measure generative text performance (e.g., LLM\-as\-a\-judge, traditional NLP metrics like BLEU/ROUGE, custom programmatic evaluators).
* Strong foundation in validating AI\-driven features, ensuring thresholds are statistically sound to prevent surfacing noise, and integrating human\-in\-the\-loop feedback mechanisms.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience working with major LLM APIs as well as open\-weights models.
* Ability to closely collaborate with software engineers to optimize data structures (like JSON schemas) for better LLM parsing and repeatability.


**Proficiencies And Attributes**
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills with a high tolerance for ambiguity in the fast\-paced GenAI landscape.
* Outstanding communication skills, capable of explaining the nuances of LLM behavior to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive mindset in identifying areas where "random LLM implementations" can be standardized into a robust, centralized service.


**Why Cover Genius?**
 Cover Genius not only cares about being the best in our industry, we care about our team. We’re a business that understands life can be fluid and so we flex to ensure we provide the environment to suit that. What does that mean?
   

  

* Flexible PTO. Taking time out is important for our teams to enjoy life and stay fresh.

* Work with like\-minded people who are passionate about both the work we're doing and giving back. Our CG Gives programs enables us to all become philanthropists through our peer recognition and rewards system.

title: Full Stack ML Engineer
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.
   

  

 When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data\-driven insights to build a healthier future.
   

  

 French and English versions below / Versions française et anglaise ci\-dessous
   

  

**About The Position**
 We are seeking a Full Stack ML Engineer to build and maintain robust, scalable web applications across both frontend and backend systems. You’ll work hands\-on with modern frameworks, cloud services, and databases to deliver high\-quality features and improvements.
   

  

 In this role, you'll be responsible for developing user interfaces, designing APIs, integrating with cloud infrastructure, and ensuring performance, security, and maintainability. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, data scientist, ML engineers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions that are reliable and future\-ready.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Take over and manage all existing backend systems and infrastructure.
* Conduct thorough testing and debugging of web applications, ensuring high\-quality deliverables.
* Assist in the design, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning models.
* Ensure smooth knowledge transfer and continuity as team members transition to other roles.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performance engineering culture.
* Architect, design, implement, and oversee backend systems, APIs, and data pipelines.
* Ensure systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
* Lead the adoption of best practices in software development, code quality, and testing.
* Own and manage our Azure infrastructure, ensuring cost efficiency, security, and scalability.
* Oversee Terraform\-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
* Manage and optimize Machine Learning pipelines and MLOps workflows for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Implement and facilitate continuous integration and delivery processes.
* Collaborate with product and domain specialists, as well as frontend teams to align backend solutions with product needs.
* Plan and prioritize backend roadmap items.
* Provide regular progress updates to senior leadership.


**Required Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Proven experience as a backend engineer with at least 3\+ years in software development.
* Experience with containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Strong expertise in Azure (Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure Functions, API Management, ARM/Bicep/Terraform, Azure Active Directory, etc.).
* Experience in data\-intensive or ML\-driven products.
* Experience with Machine Learning pipelines and MLOps tools/workflows.
* Proficiency in Python for backend and data processing.
* Experience with Databases (SQL and NoSQL).
* Experience in Microservice architectures and distributed systems.
* Track record of delivering production\-grade backend systems at scale.
* Strong understanding of security best practices and cloud cost optimization.
* An agile mindset and the ability to adapt to evolving needs in a fast\-paced environment.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's / Master’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a relevant quantitative discipline.


**Our Benefits Include**
* An estimated annual salary ranging from $100,000 \- $120,000 at the time of posting. Individual compensation is determined by factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, education and/or training.
* Comprehensive benefit package specific to your work status (including extended medical, dental, and vision coverage, access to company perks, life and disability insurance, retirement plan with company match, employee assistance and wellness programs)
* Additional vacation days for years of service
* Business support for education or training after 9 months with the company
* Learning \& development opportunities (unlimited access to e\-learnings and more)


  

  

 Please note: Benefits vary based on employee status.
   

  

**À propos du poste**
 Nous recherchons un ingénieur ML Full Stack pour développer et maintenir des applications web robustes et évolutives sur les systèmes front\-end et back\-end. Vous travaillerez avec des frameworks modernes, des services cloud et des bases de données afin de fournir des fonctionnalités et des améliorations de haute qualité.
   

  

 À ce poste, vous serez chargé de développer des interfaces utilisateur, de concevoir des API, d'intégrer l'infrastructure cloud et de garantir les performances, la sécurité et la maintenabilité. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les chefs de produit, les data scientists, les ingénieurs ML et d'autres ingénieurs afin de traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques fiables et évolutives.
   

  

**Principales responsabilités**
* Prendre en charge et gérer tous les systèmes et infrastructures backend existants.
* Effectuer des tests et des débogages approfondis des applications web, afin de garantir des livrables de haute qualité.
* Participer à la conception, au déploiement et à la maintenance des modèles d'apprentissage automatique.
* Assurer un transfert de connaissances et une continuité sans heurts lorsque les membres de l'équipe changent de poste.
* Favoriser une culture d'ingénierie collaborative et hautement performante.
* Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et superviser les systèmes backend, les API et les pipelines de données.
* Garantir la sécurité, l'évolutivité et la maintenabilité des systèmes.
* Diriger l'adoption des meilleures pratiques en matière de développement logiciel, de qualité du code et de tests.
* Posséder et gérer notre infrastructure Azure, en garantissant la rentabilité, la sécurité et l'évolutivité.
* Superviser les déploiements d'infrastructure en tant que code (IaC) basés sur Terraform.
* Gérer et optimiser les pipelines d'apprentissage automatique et les workflows MLOps pour la formation, le déploiement et la surveillance des modèles.
* Mettre en œuvre et faciliter les processus d'intégration et de livraison continues.
* Collaborer avec les spécialistes des produits et des domaines, ainsi qu'avec les équipes frontales afin d'aligner les solutions backend sur les besoins des produits.
* Planifier et hiérarchiser les éléments de la feuille de route backend.
* Fournir régulièrement des mises à jour sur l'avancement des travaux à la direction.


**Connaissances, compétences et aptitudes requises**
* Expérience avérée en tant qu'ingénieur backend avec au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels.
* Expérience en conteneurisation (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Solide expertise dans Azure (machines virtuelles, stockage Blob, Azure Functions, gestion des API, ARM/Bicep/Terraform, Azure Active Directory, etc.).
* Expérience dans les produits à forte intensité de données ou basés sur le ML.
* Expérience avec les pipelines de machine learning et les outils/workflows MLOps.
* Maîtrise de Python pour le backend et le traitement des données.
* Expérience avec les bases de données (SQL et NoSQL).
* Expérience dans les architectures microservices et les systèmes distribués.
* Expérience avérée dans la livraison de systèmes backend à grande échelle prêts pour la production.
* Solide compréhension des meilleures pratiques en matière de sécurité et d'optimisation des coûts du cloud.
* Esprit agile et capacité à s'adapter à des besoins en constante évolution dans un environnement en mutation rapide.


**Qualifications Requises**
* Licence/master en informatique, systèmes d'information ou dans une discipline quantitative pertinente.


**Nos avantages sociaux comprennent**
* Un salaire annuel estimé entre 100 000 et 120 000 dollars au moment de la publication. La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences liées à l'emploi, l'expérience pertinente, l'éducation et/ou la formation.
* Un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux adaptés à votre statut professionnel (y compris une couverture médicale, dentaire et optique étendue, l'accès aux avantages sociaux de l'entreprise, une assurance vie et invalidité, un plan de retraite avec abondement de l'entreprise, des programmes d'aide aux employés et de bien\-être)
* Des jours de congé supplémentaires en fonction de vos années de service
* Un soutien de l'entreprise pour la formation ou l'éducation après 9 mois au sein de l'entreprise
* Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de développement (accès illimité à des formations en ligne et plus encore)


 Remarque : les avantages sociaux varient en fonction du statut de l'employé.
   

  

**Working at ALS**
 The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.
   

  

 Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.
   

  

 At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.
   

  

 We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.
   

  

**Everyone Matters**
 ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.
   

  

 Qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, military or veteran status, gender, age, disabilities, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy and pregnancy\-related conditions, genetic information and any other characteristics protected by the law. We invite resumes from all interested parties, including women, First Nations, Metis and Inuit persons, members of minority groups, and persons living with disabilities.
   

  

 ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.
   

  

**Eligibility**
 To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please apply on\-line and provide a resume \& cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

title: Data Scientist
description:
*Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.*
*Superhuman team members for our data scientist roles must be based in San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City.*
**About Superhuman**
 Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Coda’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 To achieve our ambitious goals, we’re looking for experienced Data Scientists to join our Product and Growth Data Science teams. At Superhuman, Data teams are trusted subject matter experts who uncover new insights to inform marketing, product, and growth strategies that drive outcomes at the highest levels of the company. We have large datasets and are seeking individuals with excellent technical and analytical skills who can break down complex business problems and provide solutions with high visibility and impact for the company.
   

  

* Growth Data Scientists partner closely with our product, engineering, growth, and/or lifecycle marketing stakeholders. They are responsible for designing and overseeing product experiments, as well as conducting complex analyses to inform product strategy through advanced analytics and machine learning. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of delivering impactful analytical projects within the Growth domain and partnering with cross\-functional peers to guide and influence decision\-making.
* Product Data Scientists are responsible for evaluating the quality of the Superhuman products, end\-to\-end, from the usefulness and accuracy of our text suggestions to the stickiness of new AI features and user experiences and interfaces. Product Data Scientists serve as trusted experts for our team of product managers and product leaders to help drive product strategy based on data. They work with the PMs, engineering managers, software engineers, designers, ML engineers, and UX researchers who build new features and improve existing ones to ensure that our product development efforts are data\-driven and that we are experimenting rapidly and effectively. This role provides an opportunity for ownership over important parts of the Superhuman product experience and broad cross\-functional collaboration opportunities with our growth, ML/AI, and enterprise data science teams.


 Superhuman’s engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure.
   

  

**As a Data Scientist, You Will**
* Partner closely with growth product, engineering, design, growth, and lifecycle marketing teams.
* Build new metrics that deliver insights and expand our understanding of our users.
* Mine large datasets to uncover patterns across our users’ behaviors, enabling new marketing touchpoints.
* Design and run experiments to improve the user experience across our user lifecycle.
* Optimize marketing across our email, in\-product, and push channels to ensure we send relevant, timely, personalized touchpoints to our users.
* Guide your stakeholders’ decisions and roadmaps with informative, evidence\-based decision\-making.
* Take on a broad and challenging scope of work in a rapidly evolving company.
* Drive impact through statistical methodologies, algorithms, and measurement frameworks.
* Collaborate with other data scientists to continue improving the methodologies and practices used across the team, leveraging the latest technological developments in the industry.
* Develop causal inference and machine learning models that deepen user insights and drive engagement, retention, and feature adoption.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a proven track record of applying data science methods that drive impact.
* Fluency in Python and SQL with strong data exploration and manipulation skills.
* Has a firm grasp on how to best dig into and analyze datasets that influence the product roadmap.
* Strong understanding of statistical methods, including causal inference, to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Is well\-versed in hypothesis A/B testing as well as exploratory methods, and can translate business questions into sound experimental frameworks and measurement plans.
* Experience building causal inference models in the product or growth domain.
* Has a self\-starting growth mindset and strong communication skills, translating technical insights into impactful business recommendations.
* Is a creative problem\-solver who simplifies problems to their core elements.
* Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams, and thrives in fast\-paced, results\-driven environments.
* Ability to collaborate in person in the San Francisco hub.


**Compensation And Benefits**
 Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:
   

  

* Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
* Disability and life insurance options
* 401(k) matching
* Paid parental leave
* 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time

**About The Role**
 What if your expertise in machine learning, statistical inference, and data engineering could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems reason through complex problems?
   

  

 We're looking for experienced data scientists to challenge, audit, and improve cutting\-edge AI models — pushing them to their limits across domains like Bayesian inference, deep learning, and data pipeline design, then documenting failure modes so we can make these systems sharper and more reliable.

* Organization: Alignerr

* Design Advanced Challenges — Create complex, domain\-rich data science problems spanning hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross\-validation strategies, dimensionality reduction, and more
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Build rigorous, step\-by\-step reference solutions including Python/R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations that serve as the gold standard for AI evaluation
* Audit AI\-Generated Code — Evaluate model outputs using libraries like Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow for technical accuracy, efficiency, and correctness

**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality evaluation, or AI output review
* Familiarity with production\-level data science workflows — MLOps, CI/CD for models, or model monitoring
* Comfort working across multiple technical domains and problem types


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly with industry\-leading AI models at the frontier of research
* Fully remote and async — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with meaningful, intellectually stimulating work
* High\-impact contributions that directly influence how the next generation of AI reasons through data science problems
* Potential for ongoing contracts and expanded project opportunities as new work launches

title: Software Development & Data Science Analyst (12 Month contract)
description:
MHIRJ (MHI RJ Aviation Group) is the fusion of two powerful legacies: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) and the CRJ Series program. Headquartered in Boisbriand, Quebec, MHIRJ delivers comprehensive operational, engineering, and customer support solutions to the global regional aircraft industry. Our services include maintenance, refurbishment, technical publications, marketing, and sales activities.
   

  

 With a strong Aerospace Engineering Center and a network of service centers, support offices, and parts depots across the world, we’re positioned to support our global customers wherever they fly.
   

  

 From day one, you will work to provide insights and intelligent decision\-making across functions and contribute to the delivery of real projects using the latest technology to solve business problems. You will receive one\-on\-one and group training and coaching from a team of talented experts and take on complex challenges in a rewarding environment.
   

  

 The Sales \& Operations Planning \& Product Performance Team’s main objective rests with leveraging data and analytical techniques to guide business decisions with primary focus on the health of the company’s P\&L. The team is divided between the Analytics and the Development team where you will get to work on various activities between both teams. The position is a direct source for providing insight to help enhance the fidelity of commercial decision making for the CRJ Aftermarket and help digitize that effort by developing Online tools \& dashboards to deliver recommendations.
   

  

**Your Tasks Will Include**
**Software Development \& Data Science:**
* A background or interest in AI models and algorithms
* Ability to work with and understand big data sets and concepts
* Perform analysis on datasets to derive insight and guide future decisions
* Identify data elements and ensure a high level of data quality and accurate reporting.
* Utilize tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI, and Python to perform the analysis and communicate findings
* Develop automated reports and scripts with defined steps and methodology, allowing frequent and streamlined updates.


**Development**
* Ability to work with version control tools, Azure, and understanding of Agile methodology
* Ability to work with multiple data source files (.pdfs, .sgml, .json and more)
* Support web development team with design, feature implementation, and end\-to\-end maintenance of web tool (using SQL, Python, Git, Polars/Pandas, Dash, shadcn/mantine components)
* Create data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our product into an innovative industry leader
* Optimizing algorithms to work in constrained environments
* Familiarity with AI model development particularly LLMs and/or Agents


**You Will Develop The Following Skills**
* Extensive hands\-on experience with solving all the main types of analytics: Descriptive, Diagnostic, Predictive, and Prescriptive
* A suite of tools to perform analysis, develop and maintain web applications, and directly ameliorate the company’s P\&L performance
* Working knowledge of aviation related data; spare parts, airline operations, industry news, inventory and forecasting, demand planning, and more


**The Skills You Bring**
* Your curiosity
* Are completing an undergraduate degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field
* Have an analytical mind
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel Pivot Tables \& Advanced Formulas, PowerPoint
* Experience in qualitative and quantitative evaluation methods
* General programming proficiency, with an emphasis on Python and SQL, and tools such as Git and Azure
* Knowledge of Polars/Pandas, Dash, Flask, shadcn/mantine components.
* High organizational skills and a team player able to work with variable departments.


**Additional Details**
* Position located at East Mississauga, Ontario– flexible working schedule with expectation to be physically working at the office when required (subject to change)

title: Full Stack ML Engineer
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.
   

  

 When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data\-driven insights to build a healthier future.
   

  

 French and English versions below / Versions française et anglaise ci\-dessous
   

  

**About The Position**
 We are seeking a Full Stack ML Engineer to build and maintain robust, scalable web applications across both frontend and backend systems. You’ll work hands\-on with modern frameworks, cloud services, and databases to deliver high\-quality features and improvements.
   

  

 In this role, you'll be responsible for developing user interfaces, designing APIs, integrating with cloud infrastructure, and ensuring performance, security, and maintainability. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, data scientist, ML engineers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions that are reliable and future\-ready.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Take over and manage all existing backend systems and infrastructure.
* Conduct thorough testing and debugging of web applications, ensuring high\-quality deliverables.
* Assist in the design, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning models.
* Ensure smooth knowledge transfer and continuity as team members transition to other roles.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performance engineering culture.
* Architect, design, implement, and oversee backend systems, APIs, and data pipelines.
* Ensure systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
* Lead the adoption of best practices in software development, code quality, and testing.
* Own and manage our Azure infrastructure, ensuring cost efficiency, security, and scalability.
* Oversee Terraform\-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
* Manage and optimize Machine Learning pipelines and MLOps workflows for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Implement and facilitate continuous integration and delivery processes.
* Collaborate with product and domain specialists, as well as frontend teams to align backend solutions with product needs.
* Plan and prioritize backend roadmap items.
* Provide regular progress updates to senior leadership.


**Required Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Proven experience as a backend engineer with at least 3\+ years in software development.
* Experience with containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Strong expertise in Azure (Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure Functions, API Management, ARM/Bicep/Terraform, Azure Active Directory, etc.).
* Experience in data\-intensive or ML\-driven products.
* Experience with Machine Learning pipelines and MLOps tools/workflows.
* Proficiency in Python for backend and data processing.
* Experience with Databases (SQL and NoSQL).
* Experience in Microservice architectures and distributed systems.
* Track record of delivering production\-grade backend systems at scale.
* Strong understanding of security best practices and cloud cost optimization.
* An agile mindset and the ability to adapt to evolving needs in a fast\-paced environment.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's / Master’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a relevant quantitative discipline.


**Our Benefits Include**
* An estimated annual salary ranging from $100,000 \- $120,000 at the time of posting. Individual compensation is determined by factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, education and/or training.
* Comprehensive benefit package specific to your work status (including extended medical, dental, and vision coverage, access to company perks, life and disability insurance, retirement plan with company match, employee assistance and wellness programs)
* Additional vacation days for years of service
* Business support for education or training after 9 months with the company
* Learning \& development opportunities (unlimited access to e\-learnings and more)


  

  

 Please note: Benefits vary based on employee status.
   

  

**À propos du poste**
 Nous recherchons un ingénieur ML Full Stack pour développer et maintenir des applications web robustes et évolutives sur les systèmes front\-end et back\-end. Vous travaillerez avec des frameworks modernes, des services cloud et des bases de données afin de fournir des fonctionnalités et des améliorations de haute qualité.
   

  

 À ce poste, vous serez chargé de développer des interfaces utilisateur, de concevoir des API, d'intégrer l'infrastructure cloud et de garantir les performances, la sécurité et la maintenabilité. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les chefs de produit, les data scientists, les ingénieurs ML et d'autres ingénieurs afin de traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques fiables et évolutives.
   

  

**Principales responsabilités**
* Prendre en charge et gérer tous les systèmes et infrastructures backend existants.
* Effectuer des tests et des débogages approfondis des applications web, afin de garantir des livrables de haute qualité.
* Participer à la conception, au déploiement et à la maintenance des modèles d'apprentissage automatique.
* Assurer un transfert de connaissances et une continuité sans heurts lorsque les membres de l'équipe changent de poste.
* Favoriser une culture d'ingénierie collaborative et hautement performante.
* Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et superviser les systèmes backend, les API et les pipelines de données.
* Garantir la sécurité, l'évolutivité et la maintenabilité des systèmes.
* Diriger l'adoption des meilleures pratiques en matière de développement logiciel, de qualité du code et de tests.
* Posséder et gérer notre infrastructure Azure, en garantissant la rentabilité, la sécurité et l'évolutivité.
* Superviser les déploiements d'infrastructure en tant que code (IaC) basés sur Terraform.
* Gérer et optimiser les pipelines d'apprentissage automatique et les workflows MLOps pour la formation, le déploiement et la surveillance des modèles.
* Mettre en œuvre et faciliter les processus d'intégration et de livraison continues.
* Collaborer avec les spécialistes des produits et des domaines, ainsi qu'avec les équipes frontales afin d'aligner les solutions backend sur les besoins des produits.
* Planifier et hiérarchiser les éléments de la feuille de route backend.
* Fournir régulièrement des mises à jour sur l'avancement des travaux à la direction.


**Connaissances, compétences et aptitudes requises**
* Expérience avérée en tant qu'ingénieur backend avec au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels.
* Expérience en conteneurisation (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Solide expertise dans Azure (machines virtuelles, stockage Blob, Azure Functions, gestion des API, ARM/Bicep/Terraform, Azure Active Directory, etc.).
* Expérience dans les produits à forte intensité de données ou basés sur le ML.
* Expérience avec les pipelines de machine learning et les outils/workflows MLOps.
* Maîtrise de Python pour le backend et le traitement des données.
* Expérience avec les bases de données (SQL et NoSQL).
* Expérience dans les architectures microservices et les systèmes distribués.
* Expérience avérée dans la livraison de systèmes backend à grande échelle prêts pour la production.
* Solide compréhension des meilleures pratiques en matière de sécurité et d'optimisation des coûts du cloud.
* Esprit agile et capacité à s'adapter à des besoins en constante évolution dans un environnement en mutation rapide.


**Qualifications Requises**
* Licence/master en informatique, systèmes d'information ou dans une discipline quantitative pertinente.


**Nos avantages sociaux comprennent**
* Un salaire annuel estimé entre 100 000 et 120 000 dollars au moment de la publication. La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences liées à l'emploi, l'expérience pertinente, l'éducation et/ou la formation.
* Un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux adaptés à votre statut professionnel (y compris une couverture médicale, dentaire et optique étendue, l'accès aux avantages sociaux de l'entreprise, une assurance vie et invalidité, un plan de retraite avec abondement de l'entreprise, des programmes d'aide aux employés et de bien\-être)
* Des jours de congé supplémentaires en fonction de vos années de service
* Un soutien de l'entreprise pour la formation ou l'éducation après 9 mois au sein de l'entreprise
* Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de développement (accès illimité à des formations en ligne et plus encore)


 Remarque : les avantages sociaux varient en fonction du statut de l'employé.
   

  

**Working at ALS**
 The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.
   

  

 Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.
   

  

 At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.
   

  

 We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.
   

  

**Everyone Matters**
 ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.
   

  

 Qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, military or veteran status, gender, age, disabilities, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy and pregnancy\-related conditions, genetic information and any other characteristics protected by the law. We invite resumes from all interested parties, including women, First Nations, Metis and Inuit persons, members of minority groups, and persons living with disabilities.
   

  

 ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.
   

  

**Eligibility**
 To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please apply on\-line and provide a resume \& cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

title: Gestionnaire principal(e) en science des données - Ingénierie - Sr Mgr. Data Science- Eng
description:
**Pourquoi Postuler Auprès D’UKG**
 Chez UKG, votre travail compte. Le code que vous livrez, vos décisions et votre souci de la clientèle se conjuguent pour produire des résultats tangibles. Aujourd’hui, des dizaines de millions de personnes amorcent et terminent leur journée de travail en se connectant à notre plateforme de gestion des effectifs. Nous aidons ces personnes à toucher leur paie, à s’épanouir professionnellement et à façonner l’avenir dans leur secteur d’activité. C’est notre raison d’être.
   

  

 Nous ne cessons jamais d’apprendre. Nous réinventons toujours les règles du jeu. Nous cherchons à nous améliorer et célébrons les victoires en cours de route. Ici, vous profiterez d’une souplesse bien réelle et d’avantages solides, en plus de rejoindre une équipe unie pour réussir. Parce que, chez UKG, votre travail compte... tout comme vous.
   

  

**À propos de l'équipe**
 Cette équipe s'intègre au sein de l'organisation « Applied AI \& DS Enablement » (IA appliquée et facilitation de la science des données) de UKG ; elle fait progresser la feuille de route de UKG en matière d'IA grâce à la recherche de modèles d'apprentissage automatique (ML) spécifiques à des domaines et à leur déploiement en production. L'équipe conçoit des modèles d'IA spécialisés ainsi que des cadres de normalisation basés sur l'IA, qui alimentent directement les produits phares et les agents de domaine de UKG, opérant au carrefour de la recherche appliquée, de la livraison de produits et de l'impact stratégique sur l'activité.
   

  

 Le rôle
   

  

 En tant que Responsable principal, Science des données (Senior Manager, Data Science), vous êtes un leader expérimenté au sein de l'organisation « Applied AI \& DS Enablement ». Vous assumez la responsabilité de définir les objectifs de l'équipe en les alignant sur la stratégie de la sous\-fonction, de gérer des portefeuilles complexes et une équipe de professionnels de la science des données, et d'influencer les décisions qui façonnent les capacités d'IA de UKG.
   

  

 Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en science des données, une connaissance approfondie des dynamiques commerciales et des tendances émergentes en matière d'IA, ainsi que la capacité d'influencer régulièrement la haute direction et les parties prenantes externes — y compris les dirigeants clients — afin d'aligner les priorités et de faire adopter de nouvelles approches. Le candidat idéal possède de solides bases techniques, associées au sens des affaires nécessaire pour traduire les capacités d'IA en résultats commerciaux concrets et pour influencer les décisions au niveau de la sous\-fonction.
   

  

 Ce que vous ferez
   

  

**Leadership d'équipe**
* Gérer une équipe de professionnels de la science des données — répartis géographiquement — en assumant la responsabilité du recrutement, des plans d'effectifs, de l'évaluation des performances et du développement de carrière.
* Encadrer et faire évoluer vos collaborateurs directs, en constituant un solide vivier de leaders et en instaurant une culture d'excellence technique et de sécurité psychologique.
* Piloter de bout en bout le recrutement de profils en science des données, tant pour les postes seniors que pour les niveaux intermédiaires ; défendre les intérêts de votre équipe lors des cycles de rémunération et de promotion.


**Livraison Et Stratégie**
* Élaborer des objectifs et des plans opérationnels alignés sur les objectifs stratégiques de la haute direction ; définir les priorités, allouer les ressources et gérer la livraison de multiples initiatives simultanées et multidimensionnelles.
* Identifier et mettre en œuvre des processus et outils innovants pour faire progresser la stratégie de la sous\-fonction ; communiquer de manière proactive l'état d'avancement des livrables et les risques potentiels à la haute direction et aux instances exécutives.
* Contribuer aux décisions ayant un impact sur la sous\-fonction ou la fonction dans son ensemble ; représenter la perspective technique de l'équipe au sein des forums de planification à l'échelle de l'organisation et lors des revues exécutives.


**Orientation Technique Et Influence**
* Maintenir un niveau d'expertise technique élevé pour orienter le développement des modèles, évaluer les livrables de l'équipe, prodiguer des conseils en matière d'architecture et de gouvernance, et calibrer le recrutement de contributeurs individuels (IC) de niveau senior.
* Influencer régulièrement la haute direction et les dirigeants clients afin d'aligner les priorités et de faire adopter de nouvelles approches ; nouer des relations de confiance servant de canaux d'escalade et de partenariats stratégiques.
* Évaluer les investissements majeurs en modélisation ainsi que les décisions d'internalisation ou d'externalisation, en faisant preuve d'un jugement technique et commercial avisé ; se tenir constamment informé des avancées en matière de ML, d'IA générative et de systèmes agentiques.


**Ce que vous apportez,**
**Qualifications Minimales**
**Années d'expérience:**
* Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en science des données, en apprentissage automatique (ML) ou dans une discipline quantitative connexe.
* Plus de 5 ans d'expérience formelle en gestion d'équipe, acquise dans un environnement technique axé sur la science des données ou le ML.


 Leadership et développement des talents
   

  

* Expérience formelle en gestion, assortie d'un historique avéré dans le développement de talents seniors en science des données ; une expérience dans le coaching par l'intermédiaire de managers constitue un atout.
* Capacité démontrée à piloter la calibration des performances, à gérer le recrutement de profils seniors de bout en bout, et à gérer des situations humaines complexes avec empathie et clarté.


**Exécution Et Responsabilité Opérationnelle**
* Historique avéré dans la réalisation d'initiatives complexes et plurifases en science des données, de la planification jusqu'à la mise en production ; maîtrise de la définition des priorités, de la gestion des interdépendances et de l'allocation des ressources dans des environnements matriciels.
* Excellentes compétences en communication : capacité à traduire et expliquer clairement des travaux techniques aux cadres dirigeants, aux partenaires non techniques et aux parties prenantes exécutives.


**Stratégie Et Sens Des Affaires**
* Compréhension approfondie des dynamiques commerciales et des tendances du secteur de l'IA/ML ; capacité démontrée à orienter les décisions d'investissement et à apporter une contribution stratégique au niveau des sous\-fonctions.
* Historique avéré dans l'influence auprès de la haute direction et des cadres dirigeants chez les clients ; capacité à nouer des relations de confiance et durables au\-delà des frontières organisationnelles.


**Expertise Technique Approfondie**
* Compréhension de niveau expert dans plusieurs domaines de spécialisation de la science des données : modélisation statistique, cycle de vie du ML, conception d'expérimentations et évaluation de modèles.
* Solide familiarité avec l'IA moderne : LLM, IA générative, RAG, systèmes agentiques et développement de modèles spécifiques à un domaine.
* Expertise technique suffisamment approfondie pour définir les normes de modélisation à l'échelle de l'organisation, évaluer rigoureusement les livrables des équipes et calibrer le recrutement de contributeurs individuels (IC) de niveau senior.
* Diplôme d'études supérieures (Master ou Doctorat) dans un domaine quantitatif, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente au niveau de « Senior Staff Data Scientist ».


**Qualifications Souhaitées**
**Connaissances sectorielles:**
* Expérience dans l'IA/ML appliquée au secteur de la santé, aux technologies RH ou à la modélisation ML dans d'autres secteurs verticaux.
* Familiarité avec les taxonomies de connaissances, les ontologies ou les cadres de normalisation (par ex. compétences, emplois, professions).
* Expérience ou formation en IA responsable, en gouvernance de modèles ou en travaux ML liés à la conformité réglementaire.
* Expérience dans la conception de systèmes d'IA agentiques, les cadres d'évaluation ou l'orchestration multi\-agents.


**Profil De L’entreprise**
 UKG est la plateforme de gestion des effectifs qui met les informations stratégiques qui les concernent à l’œuvre. **About The Role**
 What if your expertise in machine learning, statistical inference, and data engineering could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems reason through complex problems? We're looking for data scientists with advanced degrees to challenge, audit, and refine cutting\-edge AI models — helping them think more rigorously, reason more accurately, and perform at a higher level.

* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

* Design Advanced Challenges: Develop complex, domain\-specific data science problems spanning hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross\-validation strategies, dimensionality reduction, and more — problems that genuinely push AI reasoning to its limits
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions: Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including Python and R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations that serve as authoritative reference answers
* Audit AI\-Generated Code: Evaluate AI outputs using libraries like Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow — assessing them for technical accuracy, efficiency, and correctness
* Identify and Document Failure Modes: Catch logical errors in AI reasoning such as data leakage, overfitting, and improper handling of imbalanced datasets, then provide structured feedback that improves model behaviour
* Refine Model Reasoning: Help shape how AI models approach statistical and algorithmic problems by documenting every meaningful failure and guiding iterative improvements


**Who You Are**
* Currently pursuing or have completed a Master's or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field with a strong data analysis focus
* Solid foundational knowledge across core areas such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop), or NLP
* Able to communicate highly technical concepts — algorithmic logic, statistical results, mathematical derivations — clearly and precisely in written form
* Naturally detail\-oriented: you catch errors in code syntax, mathematical notation, and statistical reasoning that others miss
* Self\-directed and comfortable working independently on technical tasks
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or model evaluation systems
* Proficiency in production\-level data science workflows such as MLOps or CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models
* Familiarity with prompt engineering or working with large language models
* Experience writing technical documentation or academic\-style explanations of complex methods


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly with industry\-leading AI research teams and language models at the frontier of the field
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you, on your own schedule
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, technically rigorous work
* Make a direct, measurable impact on how the next generation of AI understands and applies data science
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Experiments
description:
**Job Description** **Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**


Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora,你好, hallo, vítejte!


Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

**Where and how you can work**


Our flagship campus is in Sydney. We also have a campus in Melbourne and co\-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide. But you have choice in where and how you work. That means if you want to do your thing in the office (if you're near one), at home or a bit of both, it's up to you.

**What you’d be doing in this role**


As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

**At the moment, this role is focused on:**

* Play a leading role in the technical vision for Pilot, Canva's A/B testing and experimentation platform, setting the direction for how we evolve toward AI\-driven product decisions at Canva's scale.
* Build the technical roadmap for AI\-driven, self\-serve product insights, working closely with PM, PD, Data Science and other teams to make sure the roadmap reflects what teams actually need.
* Shape the architecture and design of the experiments platform to handle Canva's growing scale. Write design docs, run design reviews, and make the big calls on how the system evolves, with a particular focus on improving analysis pipeline reliability and latency.
* Be the technical north star for the team. You'll mentor and guide engineers through complex problems, help set a high bar for how we build, and bring strong customer empathy to everything we ship, because our customers are every product team at Canva.
* Drive cross\-team initiatives across Product Platform. Pilot doesn't exist in isolation. You'll work closely with other platform teams, as well as PM, PD, and Data Science, to make sure our systems fit together and raise the bar company\-wide.

**You're probably a match if**

* Experience developing distributed web applications on the JVM; experience writing Java (experience with other JVM languages such as Scala, Kotlin, etc is a plus).
* Experience with planning, executing architectural changes, and a creative and conceptual problem\-solving approach as opposed to a framework or library focused.
* Deep knowledge of computer science and engineering fundamentals: concurrency, data structures, and distributed systems. An understanding of resiliency techniques and patterns like load balancing, throttling, back pressure, and circuit breaking.
* Experience working in large distributed cloud environments (ideally AWS), experience with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes and Terraform is a plus.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills, both written and verbal. You're comfortable working across engineering, PM, PD, and Data Science to bring different perspectives together.
* Experience facilitating collaboration and fostering positive working relationships between stakeholders and engineers, promoting a culture of trust, respect, and open communication.
* Experience guiding and mentoring other engineers, helping unblock technical challenges and being an all\-around role model.
* A genuine curiosity about how AI can transform experimentation, not just as a feature to ship, but as a way to fundamentally change how teams get to insights. Think AI\-assisted experiment design, automated analysis, or reducing the time from experiment end to decision.
* Experience working with large distributed data processing systems (e.g. Snowflake), with strong SQL and data modelling skills. You'll work closely with data scientists, so experience collaborating with DS is essential in this role.
* A foundational understanding of core statistical concepts relevant to experimentation is a plus but not required, such as randomisation, statistical inference, power analysis, and natural variation. You don't need to be a statistician, but if you understand why these things matter it'll help you build systems that produce trustworthy results at scale and collaborate effectively with data scientists.

**About the team**


The Experiments team is part of PIE (Product Insights Enablement), a group of engineers, data scientists, and product designers building the internal platforms that help Canva move fast and make confident product decisions.


We own Pilot, Canva's A/B testing and experimentation platform. Pilot is the system that lets every product team at Canva design, launch, and measure experiments, from a 1% rollout to a global feature release. When a Canvanaut wants to know whether a new feature is actually working, or which variant of that feature works best, they're relying on us.


On the engineering side, that means owning the full stack: the statistical engine that calculates experiment results, the analysis service that processes millions of metrics, the data pipelines that keep everything fresh, and the UI that makes results legible for data scientists, engineers, product managers, and designers alike.


If you care about getting experimentation right, statistically, operationally, and at scale, this is the place to do it.

**About the Role**


This is a Staff Software Engineer role on the Experiments team, where you will be responsible for shaping the vision of Experiments at Canva. You'll be one of the most experienced engineers in the room, and the team will look to you to raise the bar technically and help everyone grow.


Customer empathy is at the core of this role. You're building systems that product teams across Canva rely on every day, so keeping their needs front and centre shapes every technical decision you make. Your customers are Canvanauts from all kinds of disciplines; data scientists, engineers, designers, product managers, each with their own way of working but all looking for the same thing: a clear answer on their experiment.


Key technical challenges include making experimentation faster and more cost\-efficient to support rapid idea testing, and evolving the platform for the AI era:

* Adapting the platform for the AI era, both to enable AI native interactions and enable Canvanauts to iterate at speed ensuring the feedback loop is fast enough to keep pace with teams who are now shipping code at a speed that wasn't possible before.
* Improving the reliability of our analysis pipeline. We handle a large volume of data at scale, with a low margin for error, and that bar only gets higher as Canva grows.
* Making complex things simple. You'll build experiences that tell teams clearly how their experiment is going and what to do next, while still giving them the depth and detail they need when they want to dig in.


In addition to the technical work, you'll collaborate with Data Scientists, Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, and Designers to determine the platform's future direction. You'll work closely with leads across Product Platform, a supergroup with a mission to enable more informed product decisions at Canva's scale.

**What's in it for you?**


Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

**Here's a taste of what's on offer:**

* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents \& carers
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

**Other stuff to know**


We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.


Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

This individual will investigate and develop solutions to track, monitor and improve our ecosystem. * Hands on experience with visualization tools like Tableau or Looker

* Hands on experience in A/B testing and statistical modeling/forecasting



  
 



  
 


**Our Hybrid Work Approach** 

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families.  Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist with a passion for applying advanced analytics to real\-world environmental challenges. Our Technology, Data, and Software Development teams deliver high\-impact solutions for national governments, environmental agencies, infrastructure operators, and international development organisations. We specialise in complex analytical and modelling projects across climate risk, hydrology, geospatial analysis, and machine learning, supporting clients such as local councils, the Environment Agency, and Water and Sewerage Companies.

Our work enables better decision\-making for climate adaptation and resilience planning using large, complex datasets and advanced techniques. This role will provide technical leadership across projects while supporting business development and the continued growth of our data science capability.

You will be joining an award\-winning environmental and engineering consultancy which puts innovation, sustainability and resilience at the heart of its work. We are independent and staff\-owned under a stewardship model which drives long term decision making and investment. We have offices in the UK, Ireland, Romania, India, Singapore and Australia.

Our people are all important and we invest heavily in life\-long learning and skills development. We support hybrid working which provides for greater flexibility with the way that we work.

Visit https://www.jbaconsulting.com/ to find out more.

**The role**

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will provide technical leadership across multiple projects, shaping analytical approaches and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality data science outputs. You will work closely with project managers and technical leads to scope work, manage delivery, and embed appropriate levels of data science expertise into project teams.

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

· Leading the design and implementation of analytical workflows, models, and geospatial processes across environmental and climate related datasets.

· Acting as technical lead on projects, developing and defending methodologies suitable for client and regulatory scrutiny.

· Reviewing and quality assuring analytical code, promoting best practice in documentation, version control, testing, and reproducibility.

· Delivering work across multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring outputs are produced to time and quality expectations.

· Communicating complex technical findings clearly to both specialist and non technical stakeholders.

· Contributing to proposal writing and work winning activities, including methodology development, costing, and articulating project value.

· Engaging directly with clients to shape analytical approaches, identify emerging needs, and build long term relationships.

· Providing mentoring and technical guidance to early career data scientists and analysts, supporting their professional development.

**The team member we are looking for:**

You will be a confident and proactive technical leader who combines strong analytical depth with effective communication skills. You will be comfortable taking ownership of complex technical challenges, supporting colleagues through mentoring and code review, and translating advanced quantitative methods into clear, accessible insights.

You will enjoy working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams, balancing hands\-on technical work with broader leadership and commercial responsibilities. A strong sense of quality, and effective communication are essential.

**Applicants will have:**

· Strong Python skills, with experience writing and reviewing production quality analytical code.

· Practical experience with machine learning techniques, including deep learning models such as CNNs, LSTMs, and GRUs.

· Experience working with environmental datasets, including climate, hydrological, or ecological data.

· Excellent knowledge of GIS and geospatial analysis using Python libraries such as rasterio, GDAL, GeoPandas, and Shapely.

· Experience acting as a technical lead or subject matter expert within multidisciplinary project teams.

· Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

**The right candidate should:**

· Be willing to contribute to bids and proposals, including scoping and costing analytical work.

· Enjoy supporting teams and creating an environment where developers can excel. This includes mentoring early career data scientists.

· Have a desire to work across different technologies and continually develop their skills.

· Be comfortable making technical decisions and providing clear guidance to teams.

· Have a strong interest in advancing best practice in environmental and geospatial data science.

**Desirable attributes for the role:**

· Working knowledge of R.

· Experience working with AWS cloud computing environments.

· A strong statistical foundation, with the ability to apply a range of methods (including multivariate approaches) to real world datasets.

· Familiarity with Docker and DevOps style workflows.

· Interest in contributing to thought leadership, innovation proposals, technical publications, or conferences.
